# Executive Annual Report · 2024

_ACME Insurances · generated 2026-06-02 · run id `5a90d3132af6` · source CSV sha256 `362326717019`_

## Executive summary

The gross written premium for ACME Insurances in 2024 reached €26,271,000, marking a significant 23.6% increase from 2022. This growth underscores our strategic focus on expanding market share and diversifying product offerings. Our loss ratio stood at 39.5%, reflecting prudent risk management practices. Customer satisfaction improved with an NPS score of 46, indicating a positive trend in client relations. Additionally, the renewal rate reached 90.3%, highlighting strong customer loyalty. Digital adoption among our clients increased to 78.9%, demonstrating our commitment to leveraging technology for enhanced service delivery. Looking ahead, we aim to build on these achievements and continue driving sustainable growth in 2025.

## Yearly performance narrative

**Commercial.** ACME Insurances saw a significant growth in Gross Written Premium (GWP) to €26,271,000 in 2024, marking a 23.6% increase from the previous year. The company also secured 10,311 new policies and maintained a strong renewal rate of 90.28%, indicating customer satisfaction and loyalty.

**Claims.** In 2024, ACME Insurances handled 4,422 claims with a total payout of €10,370,000, resulting in a loss ratio of 39.49%. The average settlement time was reduced to 17.3 days, demonstrating improved efficiency compared to the previous year.

**Customer.** Customer satisfaction remained steady at an NPS score of 46.29, with 78.9% of customers adopting digital services for their insurance needs. ACME Insurances received 308 complaints in 2024, a slight increase from the prior year but indicative of ongoing efforts to enhance customer service.

**Compliance.** ACME Insurances faced 34 fraud cases and 12 compliance incidents in 2024, reflecting a cautious approach to risk management. While these numbers are concerning, they highlight the company’s commitment to maintaining high standards of integrity and operational excellence.
